verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is a virtual mailbox service that documents APIs, AI summaries, automatic labels and junk filtering, so asking about managing automations is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions versioning, reviewing or rolling back automations or rules. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is "none".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
